method: Merge only consecutive same-parent path siblings with identical non-d attributes. Fully opaque inherited fill:none strokes only; no IDs/pathLength/events/dashes/markers/filters/masks/clips. Full unchanged d strings concatenated in order with initial absoluteM boundaries; groups,text,styles,transforms and paint order retained.

pixel_comparison.qualification: Identical geometric commands do not imply bit-identical antialiased pixels after stroke-subpath merging.

scope: Lossless SVG geometry optimization; component table is maintained separately.
